notes: Period times are elapsed time in the ORIGINAL downloaded video (H:MM:SS or MM:SS), from the real kick-off to the real final whistle of each half, stoppage time included.
League matches have no extra time: stoppage time belongs to its own half, so only periods 1 and 2 are used here.
home_dir_1h: which way the HOME team attacks on screen in the 1st half (R = left to right, L = right to left). Only the report needs it; tracking runs without it.
swap_teams: set true if the smoke-test preview shows the home team labelled 'away'. No GPU rerun is needed; labels are swapped when the chunks are combined.
frame_stride auto = about 10 samples per second (3 on a 30 fps video, 6 on 60 fps). YouTube live replays are often 60 fps only.
match_id is shared with the Pitchside Tagger: type the same id in the Tagger's Match ID field when you create the match.
